AI 写的代码太多，Git 扛不住了：OpenAI 保留 Git 只换服务器，Anthropic 自己做了一套新系统

OpenAI 11 月 2 日发文介绍 Pando，一套自研的 Git 服务器后端。上个月 13 日，Anthropic 也发文介绍了自研的源代码管理系统 Scion。

两家碰到的是同一个问题：AI agent
posts.quoted: We built Pando, a new Git backend for our monorepo, to handle more pushes and fetches without changing how our engineers and agents use Git. Pando cut push latency by ~80% and now serves nearly a petabyte of Git data a day. We can grow Git capacity alongside agent usage.

No training, no gradient computation—GPT-6 Astra directly modified the weights of another model: it only altered 0.016% of the weights in Qwen3.5-0.8B, boosting the MATH-500 math accuracy from 7.9% to 48.1%, about 6 times higher.

This is a blog post from four MIT CSAIL
posts.quoted: We asked GPT-6 Astra to edit Qwen3.5-0.8B weights to improve math. It directly changed only 0.016% of weights, fixing 0.8B's reasoning loops & improving math up to 6x and even instruction following 3x, without gradients or training. We call this Weight-Space Programming:

Claude API Public Beta Message Threads: No Need to Resend History for Long Conversations Each Round, Faster Replies, Same Pricing

Anthropic today launched a public beta for "message threads" in the Messages API (the primary interface developers use to call Claude): The server
posts.quoted: Message threads are now in public beta on the Messages API. The API caches your conversation on the server between turns, so instead of resending the full conversation, you send only new messages and the previous message ID, and Claude starts responding sooner.
